focus: D2 Security - output surfaces, schema copies, plugin mirror, diagnostics writer

findingDetails.title: Runtime vocabulary drift - three hardcoded enum copies reject the four runtimes phase 002 added
findingDetails.evidence: advisor-runtime-values.ts declares the tuple the single source of truth, and the record validators accept all seven runtimes via enumIncludes(ADVISOR_RUNTIME_VALUES), but outcomeEvents[].runtime remains ['claude','copilot','opencode'] in the daemon zod schema, the advisor_validate tool descriptor (runtime/tools/advisor-validate.ts:22) and the CLI manifest (runtime/skill-advisor-cli-manifest.ts:89). A pi/codex/cursor/devin outcome event is rejected by both the daemon (-32602) and the CLI, while the persist-side type would accept it. Phase 002 plan.md named seven readers and none of these three.
findingDetails.recommendation: Derive all three enums from ADVISOR_RUNTIME_VALUES or document the intentional narrowing in the schema.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Grepped the runtime and hooks trees for the three-value literal, found exactly three source copies plus their dist twins; compared against the accept-side validators in metrics.ts

findingDetails.title: Diagnostics log created with default permissions under os.tmpdir()
findingDetails.evidence: DURABLE_METRICS_ROOT is join(tmpdir(),'speckit-skill-advisor-metrics'); ensureParentDir uses mkdir with no mode and the JSONL is written with appendFile/writeFile default modes subject only to umask, so a shared Linux host with umask 022 exposes a 0755 directory and 0644 files. Content is prompt-free by design but exposes skill labels, runtimes, timing and error detail; written only when SKILL_ADVISOR_DEBUG is on.
findingDetails.recommendation: Create the root 0o700 and files 0o600; note mkdir recursive does not repair a pre-existing directory, so chmod explicitly.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the metrics root constant, ensureParentDir, writeBoundedJsonl append/rename paths, and the prompt-free closed schema; no chmod anywhere in the module

noveltyJustification: Security pass over model-visible and trust-surfaces: renderer sanitization, plugin spawn argv construction, plugin/renderer fallback parity, workspace-root allowlist, schema strictness, and the phase 004/005 requirement claims were all verified clean. Two new P2s recorded: a runtime vocabulary drift and a temp-permission hardening gap.
